programme_dialnorm.canonical_json: null before finalized measurement; integer 1..31 after finalize

measurement_ownership.complete_measurement_receipt: top-level immutable GTC shared input; not nested in the DRC owner preimage
measurement_ownership.drc_projection: programme_dialnorm only, derived from the finalized receipt using approved F06.3
measurement_ownership.finalize_effect: The existing MeasurementTransaction parent commit changes programme_dialnorm from null to Some(U5); DRC source generation remains 0. The complete GTC root/receipt and DRC owner state change together under the parent commit. Missing or unadmitted measurement leaves the option null and blocks READY/main-source work.

source_clock: The DRC owner generation is committed codec-source count. The first source advances it to 1; source0/1 still advance DRC although their AUs are suppressed.
canonical_preimage: Use the complete standalone DRC owner value in DRC-ROOT-SCHEMA.json, F06WH-compatible sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON, F32 as exact U32 bit words, full arrays, no receipt duplication or new digest.

supersession.old_awaiting_measurement_ready_union: SUPERSEDED; do not use as the state representation

scope_boundary: This is a local GTC owner encoding choice over approved F06ND fields. It is not a DEE-native state ABI or proof of runtime/product acceptance.
